The '''Pii system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] near the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] border. It centered on a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] and contained seven orbiting [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and two separate [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]].

The system was sold to a [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] entrepreneur when preliminary mining expeditions were fruitless, but eventually developed a profitable industry centered on the logging and export of luxury [[Greel wood/Legends|greel wood]] from the planets [[Pii III]] and [[Pii IV]].

==History==
At some point between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="TOD Bwing Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that [[Operation Ram's Head]] took place "over the next [[Standard year/Legends|year]]," approximately one year after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which the book places in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Thus, Operation [[Ram's Head]] must take place between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. As ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing]]'' takes place afterward and before the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], which ''The New Essential Chronology'' places between 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the events of the [[Star Wars video games|game]], including the [[attack on a TIE staging area]], must take place between 1 ABY at the earliest and 2 ABY at the latest.</ref> the [[Habassa]]n [[convoy]] [[Jess (freighter group)|''Jess'']] sent a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] while under [[Starfighter combat/Legends|attack]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Gunboats]]<ref name="Tour">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing]]''</ref>&mdash;two from [[GUN Mu]] and two from [[GUN Nu]]<ref name="CG">''[[X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>&mdash;near [[Pii II]]. After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] received the signal,<ref name="Tour" /> [[Admiral]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] briefed four [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] on the situation, being the only available forces.<ref name="Tour" /> He<ref name="TEA" /> then dispatched the four pilots in [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighters]]. The [[squadron/Legends|squadron]] departed the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] the ''[[Defiance]]'' and jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], travelling to the Pii [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Tour" />

Red Squadron emerged from hyperspace with the [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] between them and the four [[Gunboat/Legends|Gunboats]]. As [[Keyan Farlander]], a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] of [[Color|Red]] Squadron, assessed the situation, eight more Gunboats arrived&mdash;four from [[Rho group]] and four from [[Tau group]].<ref name="CG" />
